title: Reviewer-authored note on one provision
description: A short note a named reviewer attaches to a provision, kept apart from the official text. It never changes the provision text or its temporal fields. It is bound to the whitespace-normalized provision text, to the acquired source and to a source quote.

provision_text_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the provision text with whitespace runs collapsed to one space.

source_basis.description: Exact quote from the retained source (whitespace-normalized) that grounds the note.
